//: Deploying rules from here means `firebase deploy` keeps Firestore and the app in step; pasting them into the console by hand is how the two drift apart.

rewrites.//: Single-page app: every path renders index.html and React routes it.

headers.//: Vite fingerprints these filenames, so a year of caching is safe and a new build busts it by name.
index.html must never be cached, or visitors keep loading the previous deploy's asset list.

emulators.//: Used by `npm run test:rules`. Needs a JRE on PATH.
